status: exploratory follow-up designed after seeing the original four pilot experiments
target: paired-image expert consensus leg component only, classes 2,3,4,5,7
original_reference_codes_and_landmarks: unchanged; no manual correction enters training
features: 66 deterministic leg geometry and visibility features per view
original generic pose features concatenated with leg geometry as an ablation
validation: same five outer, three inner GroupKFold splits as the pilot, recording-specific 60-second blocks, <=10-second training purge around test/validation times
transfer: both directions between the two recordings, paired views, source-only tuning
parameter_selection: inner mean macro-F1, fixed five-class set; imputation and scaling fitted in training only

selective_workflow.fixed_classifier: Random Forest with leg_geometry only; fixed before follow-up results
selective_workflow.second_view: paired front and side only if side decision is not accepted
selective_workflow.last_step: expert referral; human outcomes are not simulated or assumed correct
selective_workflow.evidence_gate: at least four of hip/knee/ankle points visible at confidence >=0.5 and at least one complete hip-knee-ankle chain in an input view
selective_workflow.calibration: one-parameter temperature scaling of log RF probabilities from purged inner out-of-fold predictions; fitted only within outer training, preserves class argmax
selective_workflow.calibration_support: at least 50 usable training OOF predictions and at least five per reference class; otherwise temperature=1 and unsupported calibration is logged
selective_workflow.selection: maximize automatically accepted training OOF observations subject to empirical accuracy target, at least 20 accepted, three time blocks, two reference classes and both recordings; tie-break by fewer second views then higher accuracy
selective_workflow.fallback: if no eligible threshold pair exists, direct expert referral, with no claim that the target was attained
evaluation: out-of-fold raw and calibrated multiclass Brier and NLL
selective_workflow.interpretation: training targets are not guarantees; report actual outer-test performance and sample sizes

external_validation: freeze complete research workflow and checksums on existing data; external images and consensus codes from at least one different worker are not available yet
claims: exploratory point estimates on purposively selected images; no population interval, causal clothing effect or external validation claim
